status: Retrospective 4-bit follow-up to reading 10, prompted by its final review. The historical 704 proposal outcomes and unrestricted-code controls were previously analyzed.
sample: All 704 proposals, 14 historical tasks and 42 fixed outer folds with frozen classifier probabilities, raw input-type IDs, paired candidate/anchor refits and ordered outer labels.
primary: Within each fold encode each probability coordinate as min(15,floor(16*p)). Permute code donors among distinct input types with equal multiplicity and equal argmax of the original full-precision probability vector (first class in stored order on ties). Equal input types always receive equal codes. Retain the existing ascending type-ID order and sort strata by multiplicity then predicted class. Use NumPy default_rng(SeedSequence([153611, zero-based sorted fold index, draw])) for all five draws 1..5.
observer: The finite input dictionary, codebook, labels and fitted models are known. Observe the assigned code on each outer position. Predicted class is used in designing the permutation; it is not separately supplied on each labelled position. Also append the exact two empty-restoration point queries as a secondary check. Ignore outcome labels and refit predictions when designing and assigning codes.
comparators: Use the genuine 4-bit code and the five original multiplicity-only controls from score_resolution on identical proposals. Report certified invariance, witness and unresolved totals and within-task ranges over all draws. For bare codes report the number of tasks on which even the smallest witnessed class-shuffle count exceeds the genuine witnessed-plus-unresolved count. These are conditional counts, not prevalence or predictive performance.
mobility: Record the counts of rows and distinct types in nonsingleton design strata, those with at least two possible 4-bit codes, actual donor changes and actual code changes. Check the complete joint distribution of raw predicted class, multiplicity and 4-bit code for every draw. Record how often a quantized code is shared by more than one raw predicted class.
solver: Use the previous paired AUC and accuracy permutation guard, 3 percent allowances and slack 1e-12. Each witness must pass a direct recomputation on the shared row assignment. Only unrestricted extrema, homogeneous-label cells or a previously established invariant under less information can certify invariance. Retain unresolved cases without imputing their status.
